description: Discover and call live Lingxing ERP tools through the official Lingxing Streamable HTTP MCP service.

fields.label: MCP Server URL
fields.description: The official Lingxing MCP Server URL for your current ERP account. Copy it from AI Assistant > Manage MCP as described at https://www.lingxing.com/help/article/mcp. Only openmcp.lingxing.com is accepted.

fields.label: X-Mcp-Key
fields.description: The X-Mcp-Key bound to your current Lingxing ERP account. Copy or regenerate it from AI Assistant > Manage MCP as described at https://www.lingxing.com/help/article/mcp.

actions.name: call_tool
actions.description: Call a current Lingxing ERP MCP tool with JSON arguments. Discover the tool first and confirm the user's intent because some Lingxing tools create or update ERP data.

toolName.description: The exact tool name returned by list_tools.

arguments.description: JSON arguments matching the inputSchema returned for the selected tool.

inputSchema.description: Input for invoking one current Lingxing MCP tool.

result.description: The tool result. Structured MCP content is returned directly; otherwise the MCP content envelope is preserved.

outputSchema.description: The normalized result returned by the Lingxing MCP tool.

actions.name: list_tools
actions.description: Discover the current Lingxing ERP MCP tools, behavior annotations, and live input schemas before choosing a tool to call.

name.description: The exact MCP tool name to pass to call_tool.

description.description: The current tool description supplied by Lingxing MCP.

title.description: A human-readable title for the tool.

readOnlyHint.description: Whether the tool is expected not to modify Lingxing data.

destructiveHint.description: Whether the tool may perform destructive updates.

idempotentHint.description: Whether repeated calls with the same arguments are expected to have no additional effect.

openWorldHint.description: Whether the tool may interact with external entities.

annotations.description: MCP hints supplied by Lingxing about the tool's behavior.

inputSchema.description: The current JSON Schema for the tool arguments, supplied by Lingxing MCP.

items.description: A tool currently exposed by the connected Lingxing MCP server.

tools.description: Tools currently exposed to the connected Lingxing account.

outputSchema.description: The current Lingxing MCP tool catalog.
